observations.status: Historical rig conditional aggregate identity reconnected; no new count or alias decision
observations.trace: Particles owns private count, capacity and host inverse masses beside three public Buffer values. If an external caller independently replaces a buffer or writes different inverse-mass words and the native operations succeed, the host cache and device data can diverge; read_positions and read_inverse_masses take at most count values without separately checking that successful readback contained count records. The selected solver source binds each buffer and uses retained count for predict/finalize.
observations.safeguards: Particles::write first checks full host position/mass equality and capacity, packs the two together, and on its successful path uploads positions, previous and rest velocities before updating count/cache. Buffer::write accepts shared reference. Native allocation, validation, execution and readback success are not established by these source views.
observations.relationships: Original F082 itself names these two particle source_ids and describes a shortened independently replaced buffer. Historical q1856 and current entry 713 are related Shell-level topology/particle relationship; q625/q1859 and current entry 737 concern constraint ordinal membership. These are distinct first operations and no automatic alias is asserted.
observations.open: Supported external mutation/replacement and native acceptance; whether any ordinary caller loses correspondence; exact particle aggregate owner, resynchronization, access/view and short-read policy.

observations.status: Historical rig supplementary native-count contract independently reconnected; no new count
observations.trace: On a host where position and mass slices could both have length 2^32, from_positions narrows that length to u32 before new, yielding zero and minimum allocated capacity one; the later write capacity predicate similarly sees zero. This is mathematical reasoning on the source boundary, not an allocation or upload.
observations.safeguards: Full slice lengths must match before pack; write_positions delegates to write with its host cache and restores that cache on a normal returned Err. Generic zero count and native pinned states are intentional possibilities; new capacity minimum one does not imply positive retained count.
observations.open: Whether such host slice lengths and native buffers are admitted and reachable, earlier memory/device failures, maximum byte/dispatch capacity, and exact canonical relationship to other F073 native limits. No huge allocation or runtime action.

observations.status: Historic shared GPU Buffer contract; linked but independently scoped owner
observations.trace: The generic wrapper exposes native Arc, logical size and usage; write forwards to queue through BufferUpload and returns Ok, whereas write_at checks a logical extent. Mutating logical metadata separately from a native buffer or using unchecked write is a representable API boundary, not evidence a supported caller supplied a mismatched native resource.
observations.relationships: It contributes a shared native-boundary dependency to F082; the GPU wrapper and XPBD particle aggregate retain separate first owners. No presumed duplicate.

observations.open: Actual public error consumers and exact taxonomy, supported oversized values, API owner and native propagation remain open. No literal error prose is a compatibility requirement.

observations.status: Fresh independently registered current support, no new count
observations.trace: OuterLayer::project_particles reads positions and velocities and, on change, repacks positions with particles.inverse_masses before direct public buffer upload. SurfaceContacts likewise repacks corrected positions with the host inverse masses when contacts occur. These two paths thus preserve the host mass words on their selected writeback, conditional on successful execution; they are not witnesses of a conflicting mass write. The selected garment placement and drape paths call write_positions, whose successful path reuploads prior mass words and resets velocity.
observations.qualifications: Direct writeback and the intentional rest reset serve different purposes; no obligation to reset velocity for every correction is inferred. SurfaceContacts registered lines 355–430 are test source text only, and their displayed assertions have no execution credit. Unknown other producers/native boundaries remain open.

observations.trace: ParticleInverseMass intentionally preserves native float words and exposes validity and mobility classifications; both signs of zero compare as prescribed. ParticleMass maps values no greater than 1e-12 kg to pinned; ParticleInverseMass addition produces an effective response. Selected Shell admission calls validations before creating particles.
observations.relationships: Current entry 733 concerns conditional tiny positive shell mass pinning, 734 possible sum overflow, 737 cross-constraint membership, and 713 post-admission shell topology. Historical q445, q625, q1856 and q1859 remain attributed to their original receipts. These have different first relationships and require separate source/native traces before aliases.

nonfindings_and_limits: write_positions restores its temporarily taken cache on ordinary Result::Err; panic/unwinding was not assessed.

Buffer::write as inspected directly calls write_to and returns Ok, so sequential uses of ? do not alone prove an ordinary later Err after an earlier successful write. Native queue errors, panic and asynchronous publication are not assessed.

Packed position/mass and velocity have distinct nominal record roles; matching native widths do not establish redundant owners. Equal position/mass lengths are checked and at_rest derives its length from the packed positions.
Raw float-word / pinned zero behavior is intentional; blanket rejection of nonfinite native readback is not warranted without the actual boundary policy.
No live product, fixture, shader or native code was executed, no accepted population or runtime failure proved, and no independent lens is closed.

bounded_lens_perspectives.producer-propagation: Selected Shell and creator producers plus shell contact writebacks traced; other producers, device and shader/native consumers remain open.
bounded_lens_perspectives.existing-type-owners: ParticleInverseMass, distinct packed position and velocity records and GPU byte types already have owners; aggregate authority is separate.
bounded_lens_perspectives.admission-contracts: Full position/mass pair equality and minimum native allocation are safeguards; width, replacement and readback shape are conditional unresolved boundaries.
bounded_lens_perspectives.invariant-operations: Sequential native writes and host metadata have distinct phases, but an ordinary later Buffer::write Err was not established; cache restore on normal Result paths is explicit.
bounded_lens_perspectives.aggregate-states: Public buffer triple can be changed independently of private count, capacity and host mass cache; support and actual lifecycle remain unresolved.
bounded_lens_perspectives.type-ownership: XPBD owns semantic packed words and particle aggregate, while shared GPU owns native buffer/borrowed bytes; first owners must not be conflated.
bounded_lens_perspectives.redundant-authority: Device mass words and host cached masses can diverge if independently written, with inspected shell writes repacking from host cache.
bounded_lens_perspectives.behavior-preservation: Preserve deliberate zero count, mass pinning including signed zero, raw native float words, and successful position rest reset under any future work.
bounded_lens_perspectives.enum-shapes: Mass validity and mobility classify distinct facts; classification alone does not establish accepted simulation input.
bounded_lens_perspectives.derivability: Pod/Zeroable and nominal position/velocity record semantics were observed; no blanket derive change follows.
bounded_lens_perspectives.type-granularity: Host usize, native u32 counts and byte extents have different operations; role-specific records are not made equivalent by layout.
bounded_lens_perspectives.magic-strings: q3138 distinguishes separate first errors; GPU labels and shared output text need an actual consumer before a defect claim.
bounded_lens_perspectives.magic-numbers: 16-byte four-word layout, minimum allocation one, pinning zero and 1e-12 kg threshold have different roles; no arbitrary uniform bound follows.
